title: Constructible approximation for prime-torsion pullback cohomology
statement: Let a:Y → X be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, let r be prime, and suppose pullback is bijective in every nonnegative degree for every constructible sheaf of ULift(ZMod r)-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Then pullback is bijective in every degree for every abelian etale sheaf G [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with r times its identity zero. The comparison is the existing cohomologyMap [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. No curve, properness, reducedness or field-extension square is assumed.

proof.text: An abelian sheaf G killed by r has a canonical lift M to ULift(ZMod r)-module sheaves, with an isomorphism from its underlying abelian sheaf to G. Construct M sectionwise using the canonical residue-class action; restrictions are linear since they are additive.

Present M as a filtered colimit of constructible module sheaves by Stacks 03SA(3). Over the finite ring ULift(ZMod r), finite module values and finite-generation geometric stalks agree on the same strata and trivializing covers, so these stages satisfy Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf. Forgetting modules and inverse image preserve this presentation. The presentation may be indexed in Type(u+1), as the existing colimit node states; handling its size and the constructibility encoding is part of this intermediate theorem, not silently claimed solved by the smaller-index continuity theorem.

On each qcqs scheme cohomology commutes with the filtered presentation by Stacks 03Q5. Naturality makes the pullback comparison a morphism of the two cohomology diagrams. Each component is bijective by H; the inverse components commute with transitions by cancelling naturality squares, so the colimit map is bijective. Its identification with cohomologyMap, and transport across the underlying abelian isomorphism, prove the result for G. This includes degree zero, empty schemes and zero sheaves.

lean.statement:
theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_of_constructible_prime
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ X)
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (H : ∀ (M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf M],
      ∀ q : ℕ, Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap a
        ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M) q))
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hG : r • 𝟙 G = 0) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap a G q)
